#### Misc. Tab

Most of the items listed are informational, read-only fields. The Meter Type, Meter Make, and Default Temperature values are retrieved from the meter characteristics table for the current characteristic. If needed, you can enter other details about the meter such as the serial number, site ID, power source, pressure mode, and temperature mode.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 711;height: 662;" />

Additional options on this tab include:

- **Last Modified** - Read-only field that shows the last user who edited the meter within the Meter Editor and the datetime of the edit.

- **Existing Data** - Read-only fields displaying the following dates:
  - **Creation Date** - The date when data was first imported into FLOWCAL for this meter.

  - **Unarchived Data Start** - The date of the first meter data record in the database.

  - **Unarchived Data End** - The date of the last meter data record in the database.

    The Unarchived Data End date should not exceed the current datetime.

- **First Flow** - The first flow date is used to calculate the BLM Calculated Tier when a meter started flowing within the last 12 months. The Notify field is used to notify a contact when the meter begins to flow. When real flow is confirmed, the analyst manually enters the date in the Volume Editor. A notification email is then sent to the contact type specified in the Notify field.

  The first flow date is also used when the Source Assignment Required option is enabled in the [System Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration.md) screen, which enables generation of [exception 55](../../Exceptions/Exception%20Directory/0-999/0-99.md). Only dates after the first flow date will be checked for assignment for the exception. The exception effective date will be the first flow date.

  The Notify functionality is only available if you have purchased the **Scheduled Reporting** module.
